title: Two of the cups came with flaws from firing where there was no glaze over them
text: Two of the cups came with flaws from firing where there was no glaze over them. One of the spots with no glaze on a cup was right on the rim so it's super noticeable and the other was on the side so it's pretty noticeable too. Other than that I LOVE these big cups and they're beautiful! Sad to see it seems they stopped making them though.
